info.name: Full Text Search - PostgreSQL
info.summary: PostgreSQL platform for Full Text Search
info.description:
Index and search your Nextcloud using PostgreSQL's built-in full-text search, with no extra search server.
- Weighted ranking (title > tags > comments/parts > content), with rare words counting more in searches with several words, and excerpts around the match even in long documents - Prefix matching while typing, "exact phrases", -exclusions and OR - The Files app's filters: by extension, file name or content only, local/external/group folders - Typo correction and search without diacritics ("calisma" finds "çalışma") - Substring matching in titles and file names split into words - Every text search language your PostgreSQL server ships, including Turkish, and several at once: each document is indexed in its own language - Respects ownership and shares to users, groups and teams - Text extraction for plain text, OpenDocument and Office files (including Office 97–2003 with catdoc), and PDFs (pdftotext when installed, a built-in parser otherwise) - Settings and status in Administration settings → Full text search, or with occ
Requires Nextcloud to run on PostgreSQL 12 or newer, plus the Full Text Search app.
